segments: and this is what you didn't know about
Washington Square
Park wait hold on where you
going Washington Square Park was
originally a part of New Amsterdam the
Dutch Colony that will eventually be
called today New York
City in the mid 1640s this park was
granted to two half free slaves by the
names of Anthony Portuguese and Manuel
Trumpeter in the eyes of the white man
they were still looked at as slaves why
because their freedom was not absolute
and was required to give parts of their
crops and animals from their farmlands
back to the Colony each year which is
prophesied in the Bible Nehemiah 9:37
says that the Nations have dominion over
our bodies and dominion over our
resources over time the English took
control and made it into what we know as
today Washington Square Park
